dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, I am so grateful! Haiyaa, the entire cargo would've been lost without you!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: I don't have much money on me, but please, take this as your reward. Don't be shy.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: This is farewell then. I hope we'll meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: P—Please spare me, O magnanimous heroes... Wait, it's you guys!?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: Hey hey, what a coincidence, eh...? Ehehe, why don't you guys go back to what you're doing. Now, if you'll excuse me...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: I suggest you see what valuables they left behind. Oh, don't mind me, I've already made notes of everything.... I'll return everything that needs to be returned.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: No need, after all, we'll definitely meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: #G—Great Chivalrous {M#Hero}{F#Heroine}! Please, spare my life! I'm not with them!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: Me!? I'm... Uh... It's a long story...? They stole some stuff, and I was asked by my master to register them and return them, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: Well, since you drove away all the thieves, and my work here is done, I'll just skedaddle for now, if you don't mind!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Merchant
dialogues.text: No need, after all, we'll definitely meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The strange merchant quickly exits stage left...
